title: REAR PLENUM DRAIN
summary: Rear plenum drain (the water drain hoses for the rear deck air-exhaust plenum behind the cockpit), coupe and convertible. On each body a drain hose with a round flange is riveted through three dimpled holes in the body panel with a round shield outside; the coupe hose is clamped and cemented to the plenum outlet, and on the convertible a short hose is riveted to the plenum with special washers (View A).
